title: TapID: Rapid touch interaction in virtual reality using wearable sensing
title_zh: TapID：使用可穿戴传感在虚拟现实中实现快速触摸交互
abstract: Current Virtual Reality systems typically use cameras to capture user input from controllers or free-hand mid-air interaction. In this paper, we argue that this is a key impediment to productivity scenarios in VR, which require continued interaction over prolonged periods of time---a requirement that controller or free-hand input in mid-air does not satisfy. To address this challenge, we bring rapid touch interaction on surfaces to Virtual Reality---the input modality that users have grown used to on phones and tablets for continued use. We present TapID, a wrist-based inertial sensing system that complements headset-tracked hand poses to trigger input in VR. TapID embeds a pair of inertial sensors in a flexible strap, one at either side of the wrist; from the combination of registered signals, TapID reliably detects surface touch events and, more importantly, identifies the finger used for touch. We evaluated TapID in a series of userstudies on event-detection accuracy (F1 = 0.997) and hand-agnostic finger-identification accuracy (within-user: F1 = 0.93; across users: F1 = 0.91 after 10 refinement taps and F1 = 0.87 without refinement) in a seated table scenario. We conclude with a series of applications that complement hand tracking with touch input and that are uniquely enabled by TapID, including UI control, rapid keyboard typing and piano playing, as well as surface gestures.
abstract_zh: 当前的虚拟现实系统通常使用摄像头来捕捉来自控制器或自由手部空中交互的用户输入。在本文中，我们认为这是VR中生产力场景的一个关键障碍，这些场景需要长时间持续交互——这是空中控制器或自由手部输入无法满足的要求。为了应对这一挑战，我们将表面上的快速触摸交互引入虚拟现实——这是用户在手机和平板上已经习惯的持续使用的输入方式。我们提出了TapID，一种基于手腕的惯性传感系统，它补充头显追踪的手部姿势以在VR中触发输入。TapID将一对惯性传感器嵌入柔性带中，分别位于手腕两侧；通过组合注册的信号，TapID可靠地检测表面触摸事件，更重要的是，识别用于触摸的手指。我们在坐姿桌面前提下对TapID进行了一系列用户研究，评估了事件检测准确性（F1 = 0.997）和手部无关的手指识别准确性（用户内：F1 = 0.93；跨用户：经过10次细化触摸后F1 = 0.91，无细化时F1 = 0.87）。我们最后展示了一系列应用，这些应用用手部追踪补充触摸输入，并且是TapID独特支持的，包括UI控制、快速键盘打字和钢琴演奏，以及表面手势。
tldr_zh: TapID通过手腕惯性传感实现VR表面触摸输入，准确识别手指。
cover_zh: VR打字慢？手腕传感带让你在桌面快速触摸输入！
